ops.en: The opening state: SAPHAH ('lip/language') — Torah token 1 of five, ALL five in this span (the table used the SIBLING lashon, 'tongue' — the staged split; token 6 = 22:17, the seashore's lip in the oath-blessing). DAVAR ('word/thing') — the word-word's Torah debut (256 tokens), in the odd plural DEVARIM ACHADIM ('one words') [letter fact, held; the chain's readings named-only; Onkelos smooths to '…

THE UNIFIED SPEECH IS PARSED FOUR WAYS [claim G25-13]. It is read as obscured deeds stated only implicitly - unlike the flood generation's explicit sins - as sharp words against the oneness of God, as shared property, and as the supports scheme. And 'let us make us a NAME' at 11:4 is read as an idol by verbal analogy with 'the name of other gods' - with the DIRECTION of that derivation itself disp…

NASA ('journey') — Torah debut (token 2 = 12:9, Abram journeying on); MI-QEDEM ('from the east') — QEDEM token 4: Eden planted mi-qedem (2:8), the cherubim stationed mi-qedem (3:24), the east-mountain (10:30), now the drift INTO Shinar — frozen gen_24's staged bridge LANDS [Onkelos temporalizes: 'AT FIRST' — the east-line invisible; dual-track].

AGENTLESS by the letter's own design: the subjects of 11:2-4 are never named — 'the humankind' arrives only at 11:5, in God's inspection [letter fact, held]. SHINAR token 2 (the second staged bridge lands; 10:10 gave the kingdom's beginning there).
'And they settled THERE' — SHAM ('there') begins its span-run of five, against SHEM ('name') x2: SEVEN sh-m tokens in nine verses [the soundplay census-verified; letter fact].

ops.x: shinar are READ without prior install (known geography — gen_08s eden class; 10:10s token is a prose echo, no cross-wall receipt)
ops.en: flag, not fix

THE CAUSE IS READ OFF A SITTING-VERB [claim G25-15]. Our 11:2's SETTLING is read by verbal analogy with a later verse as eating and drinking - satisfaction producing the haughtiness that produced the building. And 'AND NOW' at 11:6 is read as the opening of repentance, nothing decreed until the evil was consummated: the same token carrying the same reading it carried in the Eden sentence. [folded …

THE FIRST HUMAN COUNCIL-SPEECH: HAVAH ('come!') — Torah token 1 (tokens 1-3 all in-span; token 9 = Exodus 1:10, Pharaoh's 'come, let us deal wisely': the next havah-conspiracy is against Israel). REA ('fellow/neighbor') — the commandments' neighbor-word debuts inside the conspiracy's ish el-reehu ('each to his fellow') [letter facts].

THE CORPUS'S FIRST HUMAN CMD-US [decision recorded, precedent quoted]: gen_06 held 1:26's divine council as 'CMD-US?' because 'naaseh — CODED IMPERFECT (final-heh verbs show no distinct cohortative form) — TIR-028's mandatory ? applies'. NILBENAH is -ah-MARKED — a morph-coded volitive (Vqh): TIR-033's plain CMD-US, no ambiguity, no ? [the mood-split by form recorded]. LEVENAH ('brick') tokens 1-2 …

The second demand: 'let us BURN them a BURNING' — SARAF ('burn') debuts at the brick-firing (the cognate doubling is the letter's own). Like every human demand in this unit, NO receipt verse will ever pop it — the project is killed at 11:8 [gen_13's open-forever class; the letter's abandoned state].

The narrator's SUBSTITUTION-REPORT held as material-facts, NOT deed-receipts [decision recorded]: brick FOR stone, bitumen FOR mortar — the letter's own lahem...le- structure. CHEMAR ('bitumen') token 1 — token 2 the Siddim pits (14:10), token 3 MOSES' ARK (Exod 2:3: the waterproofing that built Babel saves the deliverer); CHOMER ('mortar') token 2 = Exod 1:14 [career facts; Onkelos recasts — cast…
The second council-speech — HAVAH token 2: the same come-particle, the project scaled from bricks to a world-anchor [letter fact].

NIVNEH is a FINAL-HEH verb — gen_06's exact form-problem ('final-heh verbs show no distinct cohortative form'): TIR-028's mandatory ? applies — CMD-US? [the mood-split by form; precedent quoted]. BANAH ('build') token 5 — the chain: the rib (2:22), Cain's city, the altar, Ninveh, now BABEL; IR ('city') token 5; MIGDAL ('tower') — the Torah's ONLY two tower-tokens are this project's (11:4, 11:5); t…

THE LETTER'S SHARPEST MIRROR: the verb is NAASEH ITSELF — 1:26's council-verb ('let US make man'), same verb, same final-heh form, same CMD-US? mood-mark — now in human mouths making a NAME (gen_06's encoding matched exactly; the divine deliberation-grammar borrowed) [letter fact]. SHEM ('name') — and the name-seekers stand ONE VERSE after the SHEM section (10:21-31): the brother's name is the wor…

The tower's head in the heavens, and THE FEAR held as fact, not demand [decision recorded: pen ('lest') + imperfect is a fear-clause]: PEN-NAFUTZ ('lest we be SCATTERED') — PUTZ token 2; token 1 was 10:18's Canaanite spread (frozen gen_24: 'the verb Babel fears and receives' — landing); the fear will be granted VERBATIM at 11:8 [internal arc, inside this unit].

THE STATED MOTIVE IS ENGINEERING, AND ITS NUMBER IS OURS [claim G25-12]. The builders are read as reasoning that every one thousand six hundred and fifty-six years the firmament collapses, so supports must be raised to hold it - and that interval is precisely the year-count of the flood narrative these very units just carried. The tower is read as a repair against a recurrence the previous blocks …

YARAD ('descend') — the descend-verb's TORAH DEBUT is GOD'S descent, aimed by a purpose-infinitive at SEEING — and NO verdict-word follows: gen_19's class quoted ('the week's inspection verb with NO verdict-word: seeing without judging') — NO TEST [decision recorded; Onkelos turns the descent into a REVEALING and the seeing into PUNISHING — the withheld verdict inserted by the buffer; dual-track, …

The built-so-far, held as BACKGROUND fact — a relative clause, NOT a receipt for the build-demand [decision recorded: the demand stays open; the project dies unfinished at 11:8]. BANAH token 6. And the builders finally get a name — BNEI HA-ADAM ('the sons of the humankind'): the species-word, withheld through 11:2-4, granted by the inspection [letter fact].
The divine assessment opens: AM ('people') — the people-word's TORAH DEBUT (445 tokens) is God naming this crowd ONE PEOPLE; the one-lip claim of 11:1 re-sounded in His mouth [letter fact].

Three assessment-facts: the oneness; HACHILLAM ('their BEGINNING') — CHALAL token 5, completing the staged threshold-chain (4:26 calling begun, 6:1 multiplying, 9:20 the vineyard, 10:8 Nimrod's might, here the city); and LO-YIBATZER ('nothing will be WITHHELD') — BATZAR's debut, with ZAMAM ('plan') — two Torah tokens: here and Deut 19:19's scheming witness [letter facts; Onkelos will rhyme this wi…

THE GRAMMAR MIRRORED [letter fact]: the SAME havah (token 3) + cohortative shape as the human speeches, now from heaven — the speech continues 11:6's saying (one va-yomer; no new speech-event). NERDAH ('let Us descend') — -ah-marked volitive: plain CMD-US (TIR-033). THE LETTER RECORDS NO SECOND DESCENT-DEED: this demand never pops — it stands OPEN [letter-honest; the chain notices the single desce…

NAVLAH ('let Us CONFUSE') — BALAL's Torah token 1, the confuse-verb born as a divine demand; its own root will return as deed at 11:9 (the echo-receipt) — tokens 3+ are the offerings MIXED with oil (belulot ba-shemen, Exod 29:2 on): the tongue-confuser becomes the Sanctuary's mixing-word [career crown]. The purpose-clause turns the neighbor-word (REA token 2) from the conspiracy's address into the…

THIS VERSE WAS DELIBERATELY ALTERED IN TRANSLATION [claim G25-11]. Our 11:7 reads הָבָה נֵרְדָה ('COME, LET US DESCEND'), and the plural is recorded as one of the places the elders knowingly changed when rendering the Torah for the king, writing 'Come, I SHALL descend' in the singular to forestall a misreading. This unit's own verse sits inside the corpus's documented alteration canon - the same c…

THE FEAR GRANTED VERBATIM [internal arc, one unit]: PUTZ token 3 executes 11:4's pen-nafutz in the same words — al-pnei khol-ha-aretz ('over the face of all the earth') — the thing they built against, delivered BY the building [letter fact].

THE CORPUS'S FIRST ABANDONED PROJECT, held as the CESSATION-FACT [decision recorded]: CHADAL ('cease') debuts here (token 2 = 18:11, Sarah's ceased way); BANAH token 7 (the ceased infinitive). NO INSTALL [decision recorded]: every install precedent — city, ark, altar, vineyard, the Ninveh four — is a COMPLETED build; this one the letter stops mid-verse: the city and tower stay OUT of WORLD, and th…

THE ECHO-RECEIPT (gen_16/17/20's class): the divine confuse-demand's OWN ROOT returns as deed — navlah ('let Us confuse') -> BALAL ('He confused'), qal to qal, inside the naming's ki-clause: the demand pops — SETTLED CYCLE #5, the confuse-cycle (joining make, aseh+qach, bo, tze+hotze) [decision recorded; gen_06's own council-demand popped by delivery — the mechanics mirrored].

THE AL-KEN ('therefore') FORMULA'S THIRD GENRE [precedents quoted]: gen_09's practice-etiology ('PATTERN(azav(ish, av_ve_em) ∧ davak(ish, be_ishto) ∧ hayu(basar_echad))'), gen_24's saying-etiology (10:9's proverb), now a NAME-etiology — standing, untriggered, addressed to no one. The etiology's two grounds as facts: THERE He confused the lip of all the earth (SAPHAH token 5 — the lip-word's span-run closes; token 6 is 22:17's seashore); from THERE He scattered them (PUTZ token 4; SHAM tokens close the sevenfold shem/sham soundplay) [letter facts].

THE STATED PUNISHMENT COVERS ONE FACTION OF THREE [claim G25-14]. R. Yirmeya bar Elazar reads three factions with three intentions - to dwell there, to worship idols, to wage war - and three different fates: dispersed, language confounded, or transformed into apes, spirits and demons. Only the second matches our verse's recorded outcome, so this operator's effect covers a third of the builders. Th…
